title: Pregnant Blend 4-Mix Trio #16 (대각 띠·매끈 / 가로 띠·매끈 / 동심원·매끈)
prompt:

Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing four to six pieces, layered of rose-gold a ring. Painted in 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 34% of the way down her figure from the top, about 49% of the way down her figure from the top and about 70% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls), wide carved cream bands following the contours of the body, with leaf scrolls filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
